title: feat(components,types)!: a list item and a tabs item draw `content` only, and both item faces refuse `body` by name (objectui#9590)
body:
Fixes #9590
Clause-②: yes — `ListItem` / `TabItem` (published `@object-ui/types`) gain `body?: never` tombstones and their zod mirrors refuse `body` by name (the seat's ruling A+); the seat applies `needs:contract-review`

Retires the item-level `body` dialect on `list` items and `tabs` items, in the direction objectui#6771's record names for this card ("retire the dialect") and per the seat's ruling **A+** on round 1's open question: both renderers draw `content` only, both item faces refuse `body` BY NAME pointing at `content`, and every published text that taught or quoted the item-level `body` is rewritten. **Governed**: the diff reaches `skills/objectui/guides/schema-expressions.md`, so this PR stays draft until an APPROVED review from a `GOVERNED_APPROVERS` account (`os-zhuang` / `hotlong`), and it carries `needs:contract-review` for the narrowed accept set.

## What changed

- **`list.tsx` draws `content`.** Each item is `renderChildren(item.content)`: a string is placed as-is (as before); a node or a node array — the type `ListItem.content` declares — renders through `SchemaRenderer`. Before this change a node-valued `content` made the whole list fail to render ("Objects are not valid as a React child"), and an undeclared item-level `body` was the only channel that put a node in an item. The `item.body` read is gone, and the registration's `items` input describes `content` only.
- **`tabs.tsx` draws `content`** (round 1): the `(item as any).body` fallback is gone.
- **Tombstones on both item faces (A+).** `ListItem.body` and `TabItem.body` are `body?: never` with a docblock naming `content`. `ListItemSchema.body` and `TabItemSchema.body` are `aliasKeyRefusal('body', 'content', …)` — the same helper and refusal shape the node-level `BaseSchema.body` tombstone uses — so a stored item carrying `body` is refused at `items.N.body` with a message naming `content`, instead of being stripped in silence. Every other accepted key is unchanged (pinned).
- **Published text.** The skill guide's list section: `content` is the node channel (table rows, the "Only … goes back through `SchemaRenderer`" paragraph and its `os:check` example, the "Feed data-as-nodes" route); fences and `os:check` markers unchanged in shape. `packages/types`: the two `ListSchema` `body` / `children` docblocks and the two `ListSchema` tombstone message strings no longer quote the retired read. `content/docs/guide/schema-rendering.md`: the sentence on what a `tabs` item does with `body` now says it is refused by name (this change falsified the old sentence). The family-D test comments, including the `tabs` LIVE CONTROL comment.
- **Pending changesets reconciled** in the objectui#10533 form — sentence scoped "At this change", a dated note `⚠️ **Dated note, 2026-09-25 — … — objectui#9590.**`, frontmatter byte-identical (md5 before = after): `6771-retire-body-child-list-dialect.md` `822a2503a99c3201bf24704364f590cc`; `9256-list-timeline-content-channels.md` `ecedb10c5189b2c8841ea736b67c3cc6`; `9941-tabs-default-items-content.md` `ce888ebde4729564f67bca69a7928743`.
- **Changeset `9590-item-body-retired.md`**: `@object-ui/components` minor + `@object-ui/types` minor, with a BREAKING banner (a stored `list` or `tabs` item carrying `body` is now refused at the door; author `content`). Never `major`, per this repo's version policy.
- **Pins.** `list-item-content-channel-9590.test.tsx` (nodeContent, nodeArrayContent, bodyOnly, registrationInput; stringContent is the control), `tabs-item-body-retired-9590.test.tsx` (subject, control, precedence), `list-tabs-item-body-refusal-9590.test.ts` in `@object-ui/types` (a zod refusal per schema and through the node schema at `items.0.body`; `content` and every-other-key controls; a `@ts-expect-error` per TS face, read by `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`). The 9941 pin's `undeclaredBodyIsDropped` row becomes `bodyIsRefusedByName`, and its `controlB.equality` row retired with the fallback arm as its own comment said it would.
- **Census pointer** (`scripts/__tests__/body-dialect-census.test.ts`): dated note on the objectui#9590 pointer — all three recorded subjects have moved.

| `tabs` item `body` | 0 producers (`pnpm census:body-dialect-producers`; lit control: the same scan over `packages/components/src` at `1db82373f` answers 3). The door refused a `body`-only tab item already (`content` required) and stripped `body` beside `content`; it now refuses `body` by name. | simpler — retired |
| `dashboard` widget `body` | already discharged on main by PR objectui#10452 (card objectui#8290): `schema-reference.md` rewritten, the plugin-dashboard README says "no nested `body` slot", `DashboardWidgetSchema` is `.strict()`, no `widget.body` read in `packages/plugin-dashboard/src`. | premise gone — no edit |
| `list` `items[].body` | the one author in this tree was the published skill's own teaching example (rewritten here); objectstack `origin/main` has none. The door STRIPPED a `body`-only list item to `{}` and the renderer READ it — the lenient-fallback shape AGENTS.md #0.1 bans. Retiring it required `list` to render the declared `content` type (a node), which it could not before. | harder — done here, ruled A+ |

H2 (conversion): `@objectstack/spec`'s conversion registry has no `list` / `tabs` item entry and cannot have one (`PageComponentType` does not model the bare registrations); objectui#6771 retired objectui-only reads on a liveness reading with no spec conversion. No conversion is owed.

## 维护者速读(草稿)

### 改了什么
`list` 与 `tabs` 的条目(item)只认 `content` 一个键:`list` 条目的 `content` 现在能渲染节点(此前只能渲染字符串,节点会让整个列表渲染失败),`tabs` 条目不再读未声明的 `body`。两个条目类型在 TypeScript 面与 zod 面都把 `body` 列为具名拒收,拒收信息直接指向 `content`。发布的 skill 指南、`packages/types` 的说明文字、三份待发布 changeset 与一页文档同步改写。

### 为什么改
同一个键在三张脸上说法不一:注册元数据推荐 `body`,发布的类型面不声明它,zod 门静默剥掉它,渲染器却真的读它。按 AGENTS.md #0.1(契约优先、不在消费端留宽容回退)与 objectui#6771 已裁的方向(退役该方言),条目层也照节点层的做法退役,并把唯一能渲染节点的通道换回契约声明的 `content`。

### 风险与代价(含回滚)
破坏性:已存储的 `list` / `tabs` 条目若带 `body`,过门时会被具名拒收(此前 `list` 条目的 `body` 会被静默剥掉、`tabs` 条目的 `body` 在 `content` 缺席时被拒、在 `content` 在场时被剥)。仓内与 objectstack `origin/main` 均未量到任何这类作者,唯一的教学示例已改写。changeset 为 `minor`(本仓不标 `major`),正文带 BREAKING 提示与迁移写法。回滚 = revert 本 PR 的 squash 提交,无数据迁移。
